decision.trust.label: Ukuthembeka
decision.trust.description: Onke ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi olunqunywa ngendlela ethe tsho kudlulile. Isiphumo linokwethenjwa ngaphantsi kolawulo lweqheza.
decision.trust.next_action: Isiphumo linokungena emsebenzini wezonyango ngaphantsi kolawulo lwesiqhelo.
decision.review.label: Ubuyekezwa
decision.review.description: Kufunyenwe iinkxalabo zomongo. Kufuneka i-operateri eqeqelisiweyo ibuyekeze ubungqina phambi kokuthemba isiphumo.
decision.review.next_action: Yima ukuze i-operateri eqeqelisiweyo ibuyekeze; hlola imongo obhalweyo phambi kokuthemba isiphumo.
decision.review.can_rely: Akunjalo okwangoku — kufuneka ubuyekezwo lwe-operateri eqeqelisiweyo.
decision.verify.label: Ukuqinisekiswa
decision.verify.description: Kufunyenwe ukwehlulelwa okucace gca kwekhwalithi. Ungathembi isiphumo ngasodwa — phinda uze uqinisekise ngendlela enye.
driver.qc_failed.title: Ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi kwehlulekile
driver.qc_failed.explanation: Ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi lwesixhobo luwehlulekile, ngoko isiphumo alinakwazi ukwethenjwa ngaphandle kokuqinisekiswa.
driver.qc_failed.action: Ungathembi leli phumo. Lungisa uphinde wenze ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi, emva koko phinda uvavanyo.
driver.cal_expired.title: I-calibration iphelelwe lixesha
driver.cal_expired.action: Ungathembi olu hlelo de i-calibration ivuselelwe kwaye uvavanyo luphindiwe.
driver.cal_near_due.title: I-calibration isondele kumhla wayo
driver.cal_near_due.action: Cwangcisa ubuyekezwo lwe-calibration kwixesha elizayo eliseduze.
driver.reagent_expired.title: I-reagent iphelelwe lixesha
driver.reagent_expired.explanation: I-lot ye-reagent idlule umhla wayo wokuphelelwa.
driver.reagent_expired.action: Tshintsha i-lot ye-reagent uphinde uphinde uvavanyo.
driver.reagent_near_expiry.title: I-reagent isondele ekuphelelweni kwexesha
driver.reagent_near_expiry.explanation: I-lot ye-reagent isondele kumhla wayo wokuphelelwa.
driver.reagent_near_expiry.action: Cwangcisa ukutshintsha i-lot ye-reagent phambi kokuphelelwa lixesha.
driver.operator_not_competent.title: Ubuchule be-operateri abusasekhoni
driver.operator_not_competent.explanatio: Ubuchule be-operateri obubhalweyo abusasekhoni kolu vavanyo.
driver.operator_not_competent.action: I-operateri enobuchule bokwangoku kufuneka ibuyekeze leli phumo iphinde iphinde uvavanyo ukuba kuyimfuneko.
driver.env_temp.title: Iqondo lobushusho lingaphandle kwemida
driver.env_temp.explanation: Iqondo lobushusho bomoya belingaphandle kwemida endiwayo ngesikhathi sovavanyo.
driver.env_temp.action: Buyisela iqondo lobushusho endiwayo uphinde uvavanyo ukuba iinkxalabo zisaqhubeka.
driver.env_humidity.title: Umswakama ungaphandle kwemida
driver.env_humidity.explanation: Umswakama womoya belungaphandle kwemida endiwayo ngesikhathi sovavanyo.
driver.env_humidity.action: Buyisela umswakama endiwayo uphinde uvavanyo ukuba iinkxalabo zisaqhubeka.
driver.power_interruption.title: Ukuphazamiseka kombane kubhaliwe
driver.power_interruption.explanation: Ukuphazamiseka kombane kubhaliwe kufutshane nesikhathi sovavanyo.
driver.power_interruption.action: Qinisekisa ukuba isixhobo sigqibile ukuhlolwa kwaso emva kokuphazamiseka; phinda uvavanyo ukuba awuqinisekanga.
driver.provenance_incomplete.title: Imvelaphi ayiphelelanga
driver.provenance_incomplete.explanation: Enye okanye ngaphezulu kweinkcukacha zemvelaphi — i-operateri, i-lot ye-reagent okanye indawo — azibhalwanga.
driver.provenance_incomplete.action: Bhala iinkcukacha zemvelaphi ezingekhoyo phambi kokuthemba leli phumo.
driver.multi_context.title: Iinkxalabo zomongo ezininzi
driver.multi_context.explanation: Iinkxalabo zomongo ezininzi zisebenza ngesikhathi esinye kulo siphumo.
driver.multi_context.action: Jonga la manxalabo ohlangenwe nayo ne-operateri eqeqelisiweyo phambi kokuthemba leli phumo.
driver.all_checks_pass.title: Onke ukuhlolwa kuphumelele
driver.all_checks_pass.explanation: Onke ukuhlolwa kwekhwalithi olunqunywa ngendlela ethe tsho kudlulile.
driver.all_checks_pass.action: Akukho nto isetyenzwa — qhubeka ngaphantsi kolawulo lwesiqhelo.

evidence.state.valid.label: Kulungile
evidence.state.valid.meaning: Ubungqina bukhona futhi busembindini wexesha ngokwaneleyo ngaphantsi kwenqubomgomo yomboniso ekhethiweyo.
evidence.state.aging.label: Iyaguga
evidence.state.aging.meaning: Ubungqina busalungile kodwa busondela kumda ochazweyo wokubuyekezwa.
evidence.state.missing.label: Alifumaneki
evidence.state.stale.label: Bugugile kakhulu
evidence.state.stale.meaning: Ubungqina bukhona kodwa budala kakhulu ukusekela lolu hlelo ngokwethenjwa.
evidence.state.expired.label: Kuphelelwe lixesha
evidence.state.failed.label: Kwehlulekile
evidence.state.conflicting.label: Kuphikisana
evidence.state.conflicting.meaning: Imithombo yobungqina iyaphikisana, okanye ubungqina abuhambelani ngaphakathi.
evidence.state.unverified-source.label: Umthombo ongaqinisekiswanga
evidence.state.unverified-source.meaning: Ubungqina bukhona kodwa imvelaphi yabo ayifumene ukuqinisekiswa okwaneleyo.
